title: Population variation: do steering vectors differ for persona-conditioned models?

original_idea.body: Extract a refusal/honesty vector under a neutral system prompt, then test steering/probe performance under several persona system prompts; measure how much persona conditioning shifts the needed vector.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: persona-induced drift of safety directions undermines agent monitors in deployment.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: System-prompt persona sweep + vector re-extraction; guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (vector shift across personas) with held-out evals.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Agentic-monitoring robustness on open models, weak lab incentive.

novelty.reasoning: Persona-conditioned steering-vector stability appears largely untested.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Persona effects on steering directions may be largely open.
